grammarName.en: Past modals: should have / must have / needn't have
grammarName.ru: Модальные в прошлом: should have / must have / needn't have

scenario: The team clubbed together and bought an expensive fancy coffee machine, and the day after everyone is having second thoughts — so the episode is full of past modals for regret, criticism, deduction and unnecessary actions. Kate: 'Maybe we shouldn't have spent so much.' Den: 'You should have asked me first — I would have found a cheaper one.' Alex: 'It must have cost a fortune.' Pol: 'It can't have been a good deal.' Peter: 'We needn't have bought the extra cups; we already had plenty.' Then the machine makes a genuinely amazing coffee, and the mood flips: 'Actually, we might have made the right choice.' Kate: 'We needn't have worried after all.' Warm, wry, grown-up humour (B2 register, slightly richer vocabulary). Use clear past modals: should(n't) have, must/might/can't have + past participle, needn't have vs didn't need to, would/could have. Keep sentences B2 but not long-winded.
